title: Little incremental albuminuria information in the order of three clinic systolic-pressure readings
abstract: Ordered first-to-third systolic pressure change did not establish incremental concurrent albuminuria detection in NHANES 2009–2010 beyond mean/SD blood pressure and conventional risk factors: delta AUROC +0.000005, paired 95% interval [-0.000494, 0.000543]. A bounded negative predictive result in adjacent independently sampled NHANES cycles; not a causal or clinical-utility claim.
